entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
He has sought his release
on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
This is the third bail application.
The first bail application, being BA1 No.1626 of 2024, was rejected on 06.06.2024.
The second bail application, being BA2 No.72 of 2025, was rejected on 12.03.2026.
4. Having considered, this Court does not see any new ground, which may entitle the applicant to bail.
Accordingly, the bail application deserves to be rejected.

(Ravindra Maithani, J) 02.04.2026 Ravi Bisht Deepak Kumar vs State Of Uttarakhand on 2 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40311067/
